# ScaleReal

> ScaleReal is an AI-first custom software development company. It helps
> startups and enterprises build scalable, AI-driven products faster.

## What we do

ScaleReal provides product engineering services: AI development, backend
engineering, frontend engineering, mobile engineering, DevOps and cloud
engineering, UI/UX design and consulting, and project management. The company
is remote-first, founded in 2019, headquartered in Pune, India, and states
7+ years in business, 10+ countries served, 35+ projects delivered, and
3M+ end users reached.

## Mission

As stated on the company page: "Our mission is to help founders and product
teams cut through noise and ship software that actually works. We focus on
speed, clarity, and ownership, using strong engineering and practical AI to
turn ideas into real, scalable products without wasted time or false
promises."

## Vision

As stated on the company page: "Our vision is to build a company founders
trust blindly, where ScaleReal is the team they call when execution matters
most. We want to be known for honesty, reliability, and building products
that scale in the real world, not just look good in decks."

## Services

- AI Development: LLMs and GenAI, chatbots, voice AI, computer vision,
  OCR and document intelligence, predictive analytics, MLOps, data pipelines.
- Backend Engineering: APIs, microservices, databases, event-driven systems.
- Frontend Engineering: React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, TailwindCSS.
- Mobile Engineering: React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Expo.
- DevOps and Cloud Engineering: CI/CD, cloud architecture.
- UI/UX Design and Consulting: user research, design systems, prototyping.
- Project Management: standups, sprint demos, weekly reports.

## Who we work with

Startups and enterprises. Stated industries: FinTech, HealthTech and
Wellness, EdTech, Travel and Hospitality, Gaming, HRTech and Workforce,
Artificial Intelligence, GIS, SalesTech, Hotel Management, Community
Platforms. Stated client countries: India, USA, UK, South Africa, Dubai,
Finland, Nigeria, Mauritius, Sri Lanka, Indonesia.
